script.title: Inject a script into {title}

consoles.status_login: Signed in to the console automatically
consoles.telnet_failed: Could not start telnet on the jump server: {detail}
consoles.idle_timeout: Closed after {minutes} minutes without input. {name}'s console is free again.
consoles.platform_full: The platform has reached its maximum number of open consoles. Try again shortly.
consoles.client_full: You can keep at most {max} consoles open. Close one first.
consoles.rate_limited: Too many consoles opened in the last minute. Wait a moment and try again.
consoles.device_gone: This device no longer exists. Reload the page.
consoles.not_allowed: {name}'s console address is not on the platform's allow-list.
consoles.ssh_rejected: Jump server rejected the SSH credentials (check SSH_USERNAME / SSH_PASSWORD)

consoles.warn_several_pages: Console {target} ({name}) appears on several pages: {labs} — treated as shared equipment
consoles.line_refused: The console server refuses the line of {name} ({target}): someone outside Lab Console is connected to it, or the line is out of order.
consoles.console_server_unreachable: The jump server cannot reach the console server {host}.

consoles.room_gone: Nobody has the console of {name} open any more.
consoles.control_not_allowed: You may watch the console of {name}, not drive it.
consoles.control_pending: {name} has already asked for the keyboard: wait for the answer.
consoles.control_not_pilot: Only the person at the keyboard (or an admin) can do that.
consoles.control_no_request: Nobody is asking for the keyboard right now.
consoles.control_admin_only: Only an admin can take the keyboard over.
consoles.control_gone: The person asking for the keyboard has left.
consoles.wall_read_only: A bench wall tile only watches: open the console to ask for the keyboard.
consoles.control_refused: {name} keeps the keyboard of this console.
consoles.task_running: A task ({task}) holds this console: wait until it ends.
consoles.no_task: No task is running on this console.
consoles.too_many_watches: You are already waiting for {max} lines. Cancel one first.
consoles.no_watch: You were not waiting for this line.
consoles.no_journal: This console journal does not exist (any more).
consoles.journal_forbidden: Only the people who were on this console that day, their team and the admins may read this journal.

automation.busy: Another task is still running on this console.
automation.busy_task: Another task ({task}) is still running on this console.
automation.export_unsupported: Config export is available on Cisco console devices only.
automation.script_too_large: The script is larger than 256 KB.
automation.script_too_long: The script has more than {max} lines.
automation.user_mode: {host} is in user mode ({host}>). Type "enable" to reach {host}#, then export again.
automation.device_stopped: The device stopped sending before the end of the configuration. Nothing was saved.
automation.not_a_config: The output does not look like a running configuration.
automation.no_prompt: No Cisco prompt answered. Log in to the device first (until you see a prompt such as R1#), then try again.

autoIn.other: it passes in {count} s without an answer

presence.typingHint: You are watching this console: ask for the keyboard to type.
